meta.name: Custom Hollywood search light
meta.description: This is a custom search light, probably about a metre across, with four cylindrical cans on one square base. The base is a solid box, 99 units square, carrying four pan pivots on its top face, joined by a flat arm frame at pivot height. Each head pans up to 540 degrees about a tilted axis, so the cans fan out; apply each pan's own orientation, not a plain Y rotation. Each can tilts 45 degrees on its local horizontal axis. Every can is about 46 units wide and 77 long, ending in a round flat lens about 41 units across with one light source at its centre. Four cells in extended DMX mode, one shared in basic.

Face root describes ONE array element; array.n=4 supplies the four heads. Removed four spurious peripheral openings per head and unsupported two-arm element yokes.
